title: Tip translation
description: Front matter of a translation file (content/tips/<lang>/<id>.md). Structured data (effort, cost, sources...) lives only in the main tip file; a translation holds the reader-facing text. The Markdown body is the translated explanation.

id.description: Same id as the main tip file.

lang.description: Language code, equal to the folder name, e.g. nl.

impact_basis.description: Translation of impact.basis. Required when the main tip has one.

region_notes.description: Translation of region_notes. Required when the main tip has region_notes.

flags.description: Translation of verification.flags, same order and length.

supports.description: Translation of each source's 'supports', in the same order as sources. Use "" where a source has none.
